mapper.select: SELECT i.*,p.part_code,p.name part_name,p.model,p.unit,inv.available_quantity,inv.locked_quantity FROM part_request_item i JOIN part p ON p.part_id=i.part_id JOIN part_inventory inv ON inv.part_id=i.part_id ORDER BY i.part_request_id,i.item_id
SELECT p.*,i.total_quantity,i.available_quantity,i.locked_quantity,i.issued_quantity,i.warning_threshold FROM part p JOIN part_inventory i ON i.part_id=p.part_id ORDER BY p.name
